title: Signs Of Recovery
paragraphs: “I understand how you feel, Itsuki… but calm down.”
“I can’t stay calm!”
“I get that you want to vent, but calm down! There’s still… a chance that she might recover!”
When Father intervened, Itsuki finally seemed to calm down.

What is this? If the stalker pig is so important to him, why does he treat her so casually? He treats her completely like a low-level underling. In the first world, it looked more like Itsuki was being used by the stalker pig as she pleased. Corrupted by the Curse… it was the complete opposite situation back then.
Even after saving her, is the stalker pig really that important to him?
“Haah… I shouldn’t give up hope, right?”
Itsuki approached the stalker pig, took her hand, and murmured softly. The stalker pig, with her dead eyes, blankly watched his actions.

“Um… In some other timeline, despite how horribly I treated you, you never stopped believing in me and managed to wake me up. So, this time it’s my turn. I want to do my best to repay the favor of being saved by you. Even if my voice doesn’t reach you… please, find your way back.”
Itsuki said all that to the stalker pig.
Is she really that important to him?
“Umm… should we take her somewhere?”
Kou tilted his head and asked.
“Right… We’ll probably have to take care of her ourselves for a while.”
“Really?”
Kou seemed as carefree as ever. It’s been a while since I’ve seen him this relaxed, probably because he’s been with Itsuki all the time.
“Then, Naofumi-san, I’ll leave Motoyasu-san’s education to you.”
“Got it… but still, I don’t know. I feel like I might end up with someone like that too, and it’s terrifying.”
“If that happens, we’ll be comrades.”
“Ugh… don’t beckon me over… I really don’t want that, but if we end up looping again, I’ll have to keep a close eye on Motoyasu-kun.”

And so, that night, Father once again asked me several times to save the stalker pig. He didn’t need to say it so many times; I’ve already remembered it, so there’s no problem. From the next day onward, the elder sister of the sisters and her two subordinates, along with the panda and its followers, joined us as allies. By the way, as for the elder sister’s subordinates, I remember seeing them in Father’s village in the first world.
“Nice to meet you, Naofumi-chan!”
“Yeah, nice to meet you too. Larsa as well.”
“Got it. So, what’s the plan now?”
“There’s a lot to do, but the main priority is leveling up to prepare for the waves. We’ll also need to class up Sadina-san and Larsa to enhance their abilities. There’s plenty to do, so be ready.”
“Oh, I’m looking forward to it.”
“Not so sure about this…”
“By the way, if you get stronger, you can challenge the Seven Star Weapons, and if you get chosen, your pay will go up.”
When he said that, the panda gave a thumbs-up, showing his enthusiasm. So it’s about money again. Just like that lazy pig. Though in her case, laziness took a higher priority than money.
“Well, if you’re going to make me stronger, it’s not a bad deal. Getting recruited by a Hero adds to my reputation, and it’s all good for me.”
“Sasa-chan, even though you were suspicious at first.”
“Of course I’d be surprised if someone disappeared right in front of me! And on top of that, changing shields one after another as proof of being a Hero, and putting monsters into your shield…”
“I’m glad you believe me now. Of course, I’ll be progressing with Larsa’s modification plan at the same time, so don’t worry!”
“How the hell am I supposed to not worry about that?!”
I see! In the hands of Father and the elder sister, the panda is just like a child.
“*Huff huff…* Cute big sis is nice, but give us something more seductive too, boss!”
“You guys… die! No, I’ll kill you!”
The beastmen were getting carried away. Well, things were definitely getting livelier.
“Hmm… mercenaries, huh?”
Ren and Éclair were looking at the panda.
“They fight for money, but… strangely, I don’t get a bad impression from them.”
“Isn’t it because Naofumi and the others are messing with them?”
“That might be it. We should also try to coordinate with them better.”
“Yeah. They’re probably not much different from the filolials. Maybe they’ll be even easier to handle.”
“True. We can expect some training at the North Velrat Great Forest next.”
A lot of things were already set in motion. Then, Itsuki, who had gone to take care of the stalker pig, came back.
“N-Naofumi-san!”
“Why are you in such a rush, Itsuki?”
“Rishia-san…!”

The stalker pig, who had been a complete wreck, had apparently recovered enough to respond by the next day. It seems she realized that Itsuki was the one who saved her and expressed her gratitude. However, she was still expressionless… or rather, something felt off.
“Well, that’s good news.”
“Yes… I’m honestly surprised she recovered this quickly.”
“Humans are tougher than they look, I’ve heard.”
“Come to think of it, despite being so cruelly abandoned by Itsuki, she had the mental strength to keep going.”
“She’s someone who can endure even being bullied. Maybe that’s why she’s quick to bounce back even after being violated… Seriously impressive.”
“Ugh…”
Itsuki averted his eyes. Ah, he’s bothered by the fact that the stalker pig belonged to someone else now.
Why is he getting hung up on something so trivial? I have horrible memories of being with pigs that weren’t virgins. The crimson swine was the same. It makes me sick.
“Itsuki.”
“W-What is it?”
I gave a thumbs-up and spoke with confidence.
“Virginity is a status! If you care that much about the stalker pig, wouldn’t offering your virginity instead of her purity speed up her recovery—”
Before I could finish, a sharp pain shot through my forehead, chest, and groin. I think I heard gunshots a moment later.
“Uwoooah…!”
The pain was unbearable.
W-What just happened?!
“Damn it! He’s still not dead?!”
“I-Itsuki?! Calm down!”
As I writhed in pain, I barely opened my eyes to grasp the situation. Father was standing in front of me as if to shield me, while Ren had Itsuki in a headlock.
“Ren-san, let me go! I need to kill him!”
“Stop it, Itsuki! Doing this won’t solve anything!”
“Yes, it will! This will reset the loop! I’ll go back to the start, and I’m fine with that!”
“That might be one way to look at it, but it’s dangerous! Kawasumi-dono, calm down!”
Apparently, before I could react, Itsuki had shot me in the forehead, chest, and groin. But the pain was so intense that I couldn’t even think about it.
Fortunately, I wasn’t injured, but it hurt like hell! Thirty seconds after being shot… I somehow managed to stand up.
“Who do you think is responsible for what happened to Rishia-san?! I have every right to shoot him! So get out of the way! I’m going to make him pay!”
“Itsuki, Rishia-san is showing signs of recovery! You should focus on what’s happening right now instead of executing Motoyasu!”
“P-Probably, judging by his reaction, Motoyasu was trying to cheer you up in his own way. Itsuki… accept it. You owe Motoyasu a lot… think of this as part of the price to pay.”
“Ugh…”
Itsuki finally calmed down. Still, that was incredible. The weapons of the Heroes respond to emotions, but Itsuki managed to shoot me faster than I could react. Well, next time I’ll dodge it.
“Motoyasu-kun, this was your own fault. But if this happens again, I’m seriously asking you to be careful, okay?”
“I understand, but… when exactly should I talk to Itsuki about this?”
“…Huh?”
Itsuki looked stunned by my response. Ren, Father, and Éclair all started thinking about it.
